title: Private Toronto City Highlights Walking Tour
includes: Personable English-speaking tour guide (Spanish or Russian when selected)
Easy and direct route throughout Toronto
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover a world of luxury and exploration on this Private Toronto City Walking Tour, crafted to give you an exclusive experience in one of Canada’s most vibrant and diverse cities. Explore hidden gems, iconic landmarks, and cultural treasures at your own pace, guided by an expert who is dedicated entirely to your experience.

From the dynamic Financial District, blending towering skyscrapers with luxury shopping, to the artistic energy of Kensington Market, your guide will share rich stories and insider insights into Toronto’s culture, history, and architecture. Wander through Graffiti Alley, immerse yourself in the historic Distillery District, or enjoy the city’s “park within a city.” This private tour is fully personalized, meaningful, and unforgettable – reserve your exclusive Toronto adventure today.
